name: Lockstep
description: Secure authenticator codes, always in step across your devices.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src LOCKSTEP_API_ORIGIN; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types lockstep-scripts
